description: Gridpoint-level CRPS comparison between SED (degree-only) and ASED (3-bin 4-band) on WB2 Z500 @ 5-day evaluation split

hypothesis_test.hypothesis: ASED gains concentrate in extra-tropics (storm-track regions 30-60 deg) where forecast errors are directionally organized
hypothesis_test.finding: ASED improves over SED across 82.4% of gridpoints globally (mean delta CRPS = 3.17). However, improvement is LARGEST in the tropics (7.05) rather than the extra-tropics (0.94-1.53). The extra-tropics do show positive improvement but smaller than tropical improvement. This suggests the within-degree anisotropy redistribution benefits are broad and not specifically concentrated in storm-track regions.
